basic_details.job_title: ANGRAU Teaching Associate (Crop Physiology) Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 40 years for Men and 45 years for Women.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | teaching associate: a) Ph.D. in the relevant subject or b) Master's Degree in relevant subject or c) Bachelor's Degree of 4/5 years having first division or equivalent overall grade point average. d) Experience for at least 3 years of respective teaching/research experience as evidenced from Fellowship/Associateship/Training/other engagements. e) Published One research paper in science Citation index (SCI)/ NAAS rated ≥4.0 journals. f) Candidates having post graduate degree in Basic sciences with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have the NET qualification.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 61,000/- to Rs. 67,000/- per month + applicable HRA
salary_details.details: HRA will be given as per the existing state Government rates applicable in various places/locations and subjected to change from time to time as per Government orders.

selection_process: The selection process consists of a walk-in interview.
how_to_apply: Download the notification and check the details from the official website.
Fill out the application form with all required details.
Compile all original certificates along with one set of photocopies of all certificates, publications, and relevant documents.
Attend the walk-in interview venue at Agricultural College, Naira.
Register your name before 9:30 AM on 15.10.2026 at the Office of the Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Naira.
important_instructions: The position is purely temporary, on contractual basis, not exceeding for a period of 11 months or filling of regular post by University, whichever is earlier. The incumbent shall not have any claim or right to claim for any regular appointment in University/any government organization. Concealing of facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification of the candidature at the time of selection or termination. Contractual engagements can be terminated at any time without prior notice or assigning any reason thereof. Engaged persons may leave the contractual service on their own by giving one-month notice, otherwise to be paid one-month salary before leaving. Selected candidates will be required to undergo medical examination at their own expenses as per the rules for ensuring physical fitness before appointment. No T.A & D.A will be given to candidates appearing for interview. The decision of selection committee for the above post will be final and binding in all respects.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU) is conducting the recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name?
faq.answer: The post name is Teaching Associate (Crop Physiology).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 15.10.2026 with registration before 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. or Master's Degree in the relevant subject, or a Bachelor's Degree of 4/5 years with first division, along with prescribed experience, publication criteria, or NET qualification where applicable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for Men and 45 years for Women.

faq.question: Q7. What is the remuneration offered?
faq.answer: Remuneration is Rs. 61,000/- per month for Master's Degree holders and Rs. 67,000/- per month for Ph.D. degree holders, plus applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The venue is Agricultural College, Naira, Srikakulam (Dist.).

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent position?
faq.answer: No, it is a purely temporary and contractual position for a period not exceeding 11 months or until regular staff is filled by the University.
